card.name: Going on a mission or expedition
card.fires_on: The word 'on' (or a nearby word) right after went, sent, accompanied or go, where a mission, embassy, expedition or pilgrimage comes next. Mostly in historical narrative.

modes.label: 'on' before a mission
modes.description: The word 'on' after a verb of travel or sending, just before a word like mission, embassy or expedition.
modes.example: Lamar entered the diplomatic service of the Confederacy in 1862 and was sent<< on>> special missions to Russia, France, and

modes.label: Inside the journey noun phrase
modes.description: The mission-type noun itself or a word leading up to it.
modes.example: In 1419 he accompanied Branda on his difficult<< mission>> to Germany and Bohemia

card.writes: It pushes the model toward predicting the word mission or missions next.
card.plain: It fires when someone is being sent or going off on an official trip, mission or expedition, and the next word is likely 'mission'.
